rank_math_title: 5 Days Luxury Rwanda Safari: Gorillas & Golden Monkeys
rank_math_desc: 5 days luxury Rwanda safari: trek mountain gorillas and golden monkeys from Singita Kwitonda, with VIP Kigali stays and private guiding. Permits included.
post_content: This 5 days luxury Rwanda safari combines gorilla and golden monkey treks with ultra-luxury lodges, private guiding and VIP service throughout.
overview:
This 5 days luxury Rwanda safari is designed for travellers who want the gorilla experience with the highest level of comfort. You stay in top Kigali hotels and at an ultra-luxury lodge on the edge of Volcanoes National Park, such as Singita Kwitonda.

The trip includes a mountain gorilla trek, a golden monkey trek, a visit to the Kigali Genocide Memorial and private 4x4 transport, with the option of helicopter transfers.

Why choose a 5 days luxury Rwanda safari?

Five days is the sweet spot for a luxury gorilla trip. You have time for two primate treks, time to enjoy your suite and spa, and no rushed early drives on arrival or departure days.

Rwanda's luxury lodges are among the finest in Africa, with private plunge pools, fireplaces, views of the volcanoes and strong conservation and community programmes.

  • Honeymooners: romantic suites and private experiences.
  • Discerning travellers: seamless VIP service from arrival.
  • Primate lovers: gorillas and rare golden monkeys.

What to expect on your 5 days luxury Rwanda safari

You receive a VIP welcome at Kigali International Airport and spend day one relaxing at your hotel. On day two you visit the Kigali Genocide Memorial, enjoy lunch at a top restaurant and travel to Volcanoes National Park by road or by optional helicopter.

Day three is your gorilla trek. Rangers assign your group of up to eight to a habituated family, and you spend one magical hour in their company before returning to the lodge.

On day four you trek golden monkeys in the bamboo forest. These playful, orange-backed monkeys live only in the Albertine Rift. You then return to Kigali for a final night, and day five is free until your flight.

How fit do you need to be?

Gorilla treks can take one to six hours. Golden monkey treks are usually shorter and gentler. Porters are available on both, and your guide will set a comfortable pace.

Best time for a luxury Rwanda safari

The drier months, June to September and December to February, are most popular. Luxury lodges fill up early, so book six to twelve months ahead for the best suites and permit dates.

Read our guide to golden monkey trekking in Rwanda and gorilla trekking in Rwanda. For a different lodge style, see our luxury gorilla trekking Rwanda safari. Park details are on Visit Rwanda's Volcanoes National Park page.

How much does the 5 days luxury Rwanda safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888, email bookings@divulgeadventures.com or send the enquiry form on this page, and we will share a detailed quote for your dates.

faq.a: Singita Kwitonda is an ultra-luxury lodge on the edge of Volcanoes National Park, with private suites, plunge pools and a strong focus on conservation and community.

faq.q: Can I take a helicopter to Volcanoes National Park?
faq.a: Yes. A private helicopter transfer from Kigali takes about 30 minutes and can be added at extra cost.

faq.q: How many days do you need for a luxury gorilla safari in Rwanda?
faq.a: Four to five days is ideal for a gorilla trek, a golden monkey trek and time to enjoy your lodge. Add Akagera or Nyungwe for a longer trip.

faq.q: Is a 5-day luxury safari suitable for a honeymoon?
faq.a: Yes. The combination of a romantic lodge, private guiding and a gorilla encounter makes it a favourite with honeymooners.

faq.q: What makes a 5 days luxury Rwanda safari different from a standard trip?
faq.a: You stay in top lodges with suites and spas, enjoy VIP service and private guiding, and can add helicopter transfers. The gorilla trek itself is the same for every visitor.

faq.q: How long is a golden monkey trek?
faq.a: Golden monkey treks usually take a few hours in total, including one hour with the monkeys. They are generally easier than gorilla treks.

faq.q: What is the minimum age for gorilla trekking?
faq.a: Visitors must be at least 15 years old to trek mountain gorillas in Rwanda.
